At a table of four, the team set out to build a domino picture of a mountain hare in twenty minutes. Maya backed the choice, noting that the client's ski school mascot was a white snow hare. Priya sketched the outline on the pad and traced it from START, running the back up to the long ear. She split the rest of the work: Leo would take the second ear, Tom the belly and chest, and Maya would watch where the ears joined the head.

Leo took the second ear off the head while Tom laid the body. Then Maya spotted the trouble: "the belly's still floating at the start end." Tom replied that the belly wasn't joined to START yet and closed the gap right where she pointed.

In the end, 28 of 70 fell. The team called it a hare, but the blind judges saw a wavy line, a dark brush stroke, or a winding road.
